<b>Text markieren:</b> Werkzeug <i>„Mark: Highlight text: select the ‘Highlight’ tool, then drag the mouse over the words – exactly the text is highlighted, even across several lines; a click highlights a single word. Next to it, choose the colour (yellow, green, blue, pink, orange) and the style: Highlight, Underline or Strikethrough. A selected highlight can be recoloured or deleted with Del. Dragging on an empty area highlights a region (e.g. an image). All occurrences at once: Ctrl+F, enter the term, ‘Highlight all’ – every occurrence in the whole document is highlighted, including phrases such as ‘15 November’; Ctrl+Z undoes them all. Highlights from other programs: if you open a PDF that is already highlighted, PDFMy imports the highlights with comment and author – they can be recoloured and deleted (not for digitally signed PDFs, so that the signature remains valid). When saving, these become real PDF highlights: other PDF programs show them as comments with the highlighted text and can remove them.
